notes: Tree-sitter Python bindings, Assimp native CLI, glTF-Transform npm and Qdrant Python client are runtime dependencies; no full source or binaries included. Qdrant local mode keeps indexed metadata in user library. Optional FastEmbed model weights may need a separate explicit download. Rete.js v2 and its Lit/area/connection packages are npm runtime dependencies; the plugin contains a complete authored editor template, graph validator, and license notices, not installed npm binaries or a full upstream clone. inkjs@2.4.0 is an additional npm dependency of the Rete workbench and is not bundled; scripts/compile-stories.mjs compiles only explicitly registered authored .ink copies into separate workbench public/stories. Rapier@0.21.0 in the new Three.js demo is a pinned npm dependency. The full external Rust source/WASM is not bundled; runtime needs npm install to run. An authored Python bridge converts validated Rete/Ink scene blueprints to a fresh playable Vite project and SHA-verifies approved GLB art. Recast 0.44.0 runs through npm WASM packages and is not embedded or installed. The generated physical example supplies a debug overlay and companion NPC with authoritative Rapier collision. Navigation is computed from static Rapier obstacle footprints, not imported animated models; dynamic crate avoidance is handled by physical collision/repath best effort, not a rebuilt tile cache. Postprocessing is integrated as authored visual shader adapter to existing playable 3D prototype, pinned npm postprocessing@6.39.6 with Zlib notice; no full upstream package or runtime installed; browser render not claimed. Three.js unified builder v1.2 adds new 3-chapter original concept scaffolds, or projects based on validated Rete blueprint. Imported gameplay source is never automatically executed. Real game launch still requires npm/browser dependencies.
